Name: Combine Machines Continued
Author: Sephiloud
Description:
This mod is a continuation of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7411]Combine Machines[/url]﻿ Mod made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/SlayerDharok]SlayerDharok[/url]. He gave me the permission to upload my changes as a different mod entry on nexus.

[size=5]Most details can be found on the [/size][size=5][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7411]original Mod Page[/url][/size][size=5]﻿.
[/size][b]
Currently made Changes:[/b][list]
[*]Lightning Rods work properly with [b]"IncreaseSpeed" [/b]and [b]"MultiplyItems"[/b]
[*]﻿Improved Multiplayer Support: Speed or Quantity should be calculated correctly even for actions made by other players than the host
[list][*]All Vanilla Machines are tested and should work with [b]"IncreaseSpeed"[/b] and most of them with [b]"MultiplyItems"[/b] 
(Crab Pots won't work yet in this mode and some machines are not tested in this mode like Casks or Incubator, fixed Crystalarium)[/list][*]Added additional compatibility for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿ and other Mod Machines ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21244]Strange Machines[/url], ...)
[list][*]﻿Automate should now work properly in [b]"IncreaseSpeed"[/b] mode for machines that produce after collecting the output without input
﻿(like Crystalarium, Bee Houses, Worm Bin, ...) and won't use the vanilla time after collecting once[*]﻿Automate works in [b]"MultiplyItems"[/b] properly, consuming as many items from the Inventory Automate used (all items necessary have to be in one container)
[/list][/list]
[b]Currently working on:
[/b][list]
[*][s]adding further compatibility for Automate to work properly in [b]"MultiplyItems" [/b]mode (consuming the right amount of additional Items from the connected chest)[/s]
already works[*]adding compatibility for other Mods and Mod Machines
[*]Open for suggestions!
[/list][size=2]
[/size][size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿
[*]Most Mod Machines added with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32032]Better Game Menu[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]Better Beehouses[/url]
[*][b]WIP: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22672]Junimatic[/url]﻿[/b]
[/list][size=2]
Most of the [url=https://github.com/Videogamers0/SDV-CombineMachines]Source Code[/url] is still by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/SlayerDharok]SlayerDharok[/url]﻿. My changed version will be uploaded later on GitHub.[/size]

1.6 compatible continuation of SlayerDharok's Mod Combine Machines with some added features.


- Add fix for Crystalarium and Modded Machines working like it in MultiplyItems mode to work correctly
